I have been farming this land since I was young, and I know what works. I will put some government fertilizer on my trees, not too much because it is expensive, and I will also spread manure from my animals like I always do. My family will do all the work—weeding, pruning, and harvesting—because we cannot afford to pay workers, and we do not have water for irrigation so we depend on the rains.
